title: Design System: Collaborative Kanban Todo App

title.purpose: Page headers — Dashboard, Board Settings, auth headings.

headline.purpose: Section headers — Boards I Own, settings groups.

body.purpose: Default work text, todo titles, descriptions — 14px dense reading.

label.purpose: Form labels, buttons, field labels — 14px medium.

micro.purpose: Badges, chips, due dates, counts — 12px meta.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: BoardCard and auth panel hover — interactive lift only, never at rest.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Flat-By-Default: cards/columns/inputs separate via ring-1 and tone, not shadow.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Solid Signal Blue CTA — auth submit, New Board; the only primary-action color.
components.css: .ds-btn-action { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 8px 16px; height: 32px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-action:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-action:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(59 130 246 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-action:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ink Button (kit default)
components.description: shadcn default solid button — near-black Ink fill for kit-level primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 8px 10px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(120 120 120 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-ink:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet bordered button for secondary actions — paper fill, hairline border, muted hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 8px 10px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(120 120 120 / 0.5); border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact 32px field — paper fill, hairline border, 3px focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(59 130 246 / 0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; background: oklch(0.97 0 0); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Todo / Board Card
components.description: Flat ring-bordered card — the resting surface for todos and board tiles.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(14.5% 0 0 / 0.1); transition: box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(14.5% 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }

components.name: Priority Badge
components.description: Pill priority chip — Urgent soft-red variant shown; High is Ink, Medium muted, Low outline.
components.css: .ds-badge-urgent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; width: fit-content; padding: 2px 8px; background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.1); color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Small 6px-radius tag with owner color at 20% alpha background.
components.css: .ds-chip-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 6px; background: oklch(0.97 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-chip-tag:hover { background: oklch(0.922 0 0); }

narrative.overview:
This is a calm operations console for small teams: neutral paper surfaces do the heavy lifting, and color only fires for action, priority, and status. The mood is calm and utilitarian — unpretentious, efficient, built for scanning a board in seconds rather than admiring chrome. Depth comes from light tonal shifts and thin rings, not decoration; the interface recedes so todos, assignments, and movement lead.

The system is a hybrid of two observed layers that already coexist: a shadcn/ui base-nova neutral token layer (pure OKLCH grays, compact controls, ring-bordered cards) and a functional Tailwind palette layer used directly on feature screens (Signal Blue CTAs, status reds/amber/greens, soft column washes). New screens should treat both as one vocabulary: chrome stays quiet; hue is earned by meaning.

The confirmed visual anti-reference is enterprise project-management chrome — Jira/Asana density, heavy borders, loud gradients, configuration-first surfaces. Product principle "and nothing more" is a visual principle here too: if an element isn't helping someone scan, act, or coordinate, it doesn't ship.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral, near-monochrome chrome; hue reserved for action and status
Compact controls (32px default button/input height) and dense 14px work text
Flat at rest (ring borders); shadows only as feedback (hover, dialog, drag)
Soft status washes on Kanban columns; pill badges for priority
Single system sans — functional hierarchy, no display face

rules.name: The Signal-Only Rule
rules.body: Hue appears only for action, status, priority, or focus. Everything else — nav, structure, chrome — stays in the neutral stack. If a new color can't answer "what does this mean?", it doesn't belong.

rules.name: The Single-Action Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the sole primary-action color. Don't introduce green/amber/purple buttons for ordinary CTAs; green and amber are reserved for status meaning.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is size and weight only (700 titles → 600 headlines → 500 labels → 400 body). Don't introduce a second family or decorative styling to make text "pop."

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, drag, overlay presence) — never as permanent card styling.

dos: Do keep chrome neutral: paper surfaces, hairline borders, Ink/Muted text — let board content and status washes carry the color.
Do use Signal Blue (#2563eb) for every primary action and link; deepen to #1d4ed8 on hover.
Do apply the column washes exactly: Slate To Do, Sky In Progress, Mint Done, each with its 1px matching border.
Do keep controls compact (32px default height) and cards flat at rest (ring-1, no shadow).
Do show shadows only as feedback: shadow-md hover on clickable cards, shadow-lg/shadow-xl during drag, overlay shadows on dialogs.
Do mark urgency with the status trio: red overdue/Urgent, amber due-today, green complete — text and soft badges, not full-bleed fills.
Do use pill shapes for badges, counts, and avatars; 8–10px corners for controls; 14px for cards.
Do keep page titles bold at 24–30px and work text at 14px in the single system sans.
donts: Don't add decorative color — gradients, brand-tinted section backgrounds, colored nav bars — or repurpose green/amber/purple for non-status CTAs.
Don't put permanent drop shadows on resting cards or columns; rest is flat by rule.
Don't reintroduce enterprise-PM chrome: heavy borders, dense toolbar walls, or configuration-first surfaces (anti-reference: Jira/Asana).
Don't introduce a second font family, display face, or uppercase-everything labeling scheme.
Don't soften the compact density into large airy paddings (32px+ control heights, 24px card gaps) — the system stays scannable and tight.
Don't stack multiple saturated colors in one card; a todo card may show one priority signal, status text colors, and owner-tag hues — nothing else.
